name: prompt-suggestions
description: Starter prompts as a wrap of pill buttons — the "Try asking…" row of an empty AI chat

meta.name: PromptSuggestions
meta.description: Starter prompts as a wrap of pill buttons — the "Try asking…" row of an empty AI chat

props.name: items
props.description: The prompts, as the exact text each one sends.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the chosen prompt — send it, or put it in the composer.

props.name: labels
props.description: Overrides for the component’s user-visible strings (i18n) — `group` names the group for screen readers.

examples.title: Starter prompts
examples.code:
<PromptSuggestions
  items={['Summarise this week’s tickets', 'Draft a release note', 'What changed in v2?']}
  onSelect={() => {}}
/>

whenToUse: An empty conversation: offer a few concrete things to ask
Follow-up suggestions under an assistant reply
whenNotToUse: Filtering or selecting values — use ToggleGroup, Tag or SegmentedControl

antiPatterns.good: Three or four specific, tappable prompts
antiPatterns.why: Specific starters show what the assistant can actually do; a long generic list is skipped

related.name: MessageActions
related.reason: Both sit around an assistant message

related.name: Tag
related.reason: Tag is for labels and filters, not for sending a prompt

intent.a11yRationale: A named group of real buttons whose names are the prompt text, operable with Tab and Enter/Space. Pills meet the coarse-pointer target size and keep a visible focus ring

content.tone: Write each prompt as the person would type it, in the first person

flexibility.note: Send immediately, or fill the composer
The visible text is the prompt; do not show one thing and send another
